categories.main_business_segments: InfoVision Optoelectronics (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of thin-film transistor liquid crystal display panels (TFT-LCD), focusing on small and medium-sized display panels. Its products are widely applied in notebook computers, automotive displays, industrial control, smartphones, and smart interconnectivity devices. The company also provides customized display solutions and related technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including dynamic privacy protection display technology (HVA), integrated touch and privacy technology, metal mesh On-cell touch technology, eye protection technology, TED low power consumption technology, negative IPS LCD technology, PET wide viewing angle technology, Mini LED backlight technology, and new metal oxide TFT architectures. It employs mature a-Si TFT-LCD production lines and is actively developing emerging technologies such as AMOLED, MLED, electronic paper, HUD head-up displays, and 3D stereoscopic displays. Manufacturing involves precision CNC machining, integrated circuit embedding, and intelligent digitalized production systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global notebook brands such as HP and Lenovo, major Tier 1 automotive suppliers like Panasonic, JVCK, Pioneer, and domestic automakers including BYD, Geely, Changan, SAIC, Toyota, Honda, and Chery. The company serves diverse end markets including consumer electronics, automotive smart displays, industrial control systems, and emerging segments like AI-enabled devices and electronic paper applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and main production facilities in Kunshan, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Vietnam to strengthen global supply chain and production capabilities. Overseas sales constitute approximately 54% of revenue, with exports mainly to the US and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: InfoVision Optoelectronics operates in the midstream segment of the display panel supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of TFT-LCD panels and related display technologies. It maintains close collaboration with upstream raw material suppliers and downstream device manufacturers, providing integrated display solutions and technical support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in dynamic privacy protection, touch integration, Mini LED, OLED, electronic paper, and low power consumption technologies. It invests heavily in R&D (6.71% of revenue in 2024) to enhance product differentiation and expand into emerging markets such as smart automotive displays, AI applications, and electronic paper. Strategic initiatives include global production base expansion, supply chain optimization, digital transformation, and ESG-driven green technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of TFT-LCD display panels and related products. The company employs a production-to-order and sales-to-production model, combining direct sales with distribution channels. Additional income arises from technical services, government subsidies, and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As one of the earliest professional TFT-LCD manufacturers in China and the first Jiangsu state-owned enterprise listed on the STAR Market, the company holds a leading position in the dynamic privacy protection display niche and ranks sixth globally in automotive display shipments and ninth in notebook panel shipments. It competes with major domestic and international display manufacturers, leveraging differentiated technology and customized solutions to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.41 billion, a 9.77% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 190 million, improving 31.64% year-over-year. Total assets stood at RMB 6.58 billion with a debt ratio of 34.84%, indicating a relatively low leverage level. The company continues to invest significantly in R&D and production capacity expansion, aiming for sustainable growth despite industry cyclicality and competitive pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: InfoVision Optoelectronics emphasizes differentiated, high-value, and customized display solutions, particularly in dynamic privacy protection technology, integrated touch displays, and energy-efficient panels. Its proprietary technologies enable superior privacy features, eye protection, and low power consumption, catering to high-end business notebooks, automotive smart displays, and emerging AI-driven applications. The company also commits to ESG principles, developing green products and sustainable manufacturing processes to enhance customer value and brand reputation.
